hero.title: Part science. Part theatre. All hospitality.
hero.sub: Bar manager, beverage consultant and founder of The Cocktail Tree — I build bars that people come back to.

numbers.title: Fourteen years, distilled.
numbers.globeNote: One bus tour. 33 countries. 65+ cities. Endless inspiration for the back bar.

menu.title: A career, served as a tasting menu.
menu.sub: Eight courses. Three countries. One standard.

courses.text: Where it began. Bar-back to bartender — learning that the craft is people, not just pours.
Leading a legendary hotel bar with 500+ beverages in inventory and zero room for error.
Beach bar by day, Bliss Disco by night — two venues, two tempos, one bartender.
Promoted on the floor. Running service and mentoring the team in a rooftop sports lounge.
20+ outlets across the capital — strategy, standards and training at group scale.
Six years at the helm of one of Dubai's leading sports bars — menu, team, events, growth.
Consulting, training and menu engineering — sharing the recipe book with the industry.
Taking a restaurant brand digital — growth across every major delivery platform in the UAE.

tree.title: Consulting, with roots.
tree.desc: The Cocktail Tree is my consultancy — six roots, like the six classic cocktail families. It exists to make great beverage programs accessible to any venue, from neighborhood bar to hotel group.

services.title: Concept & opening support

services.title: Supplier & inventory strategy
services.text: The right back bar at the right price, with relationships that outlast promotions.

services.title: Guest experience design
